verification.runtime_check: Started create_app(temp db, temp uploads) via uvicorn on ports 8751 (normal) and 8752 (GET /api/logs forced to 500) from a scratch script outside the project. Loaded both with headless Chrome --dump-dom --virtual-time-budget and inspected the DOM for empty, populated and error states. Checked the upload and traversal URLs with curl. Servers and Chrome stopped (no listeners on 8751/8752 afterwards).
verification.self_critique: Did not observe img naturalWidth or an alert dialog in a live browser (dump-dom only; the verdict on XSS rests on the escaped DOM). The network error and unparseable-body paths were not run live, only HTTP 500. Symlink/junction traversal was not run live (pytest covers only what the implementer wrote). A curl -F run initially sent '<'-prefixed text as a file read; I redid it with --form-string, so that was my test artifact and not a product issue. Killing run.py processes also ended some bash shells.
